applicability: Source-only qualification of the pinned Qwen3-Next CUDA-facing GDN caller
Mixed prefill/decode, packed/speculative metadata and state-row contracts
limitations: No concrete HF binding, external implementation equivalence, hardware compatibility or performance claim
Physical state allocation, release and recycling outside the readset
attribution: vLLM contributors; Apache-2.0 root and in-file notices retained in the source reference. The in-tree conv file additionally credits Tri Dao; vendored FLA carries its separate MIT notice.

findings.direction: Classify one-token GDN rows with prefill and prior-state metadata
findings.reason: The first one-token chunk may require the prefill route to mask recycled state. Mixed non-speculative input with any prefill row uses varlen forward convolution; the recurrent split requires decode-first handling, rebased prefill lengths and an output stitch.
findings.revisit_when: Inspect first and resumed one-token rows and a mixed batch with longer prefill. Treat speculative-row classification as a separate test.

findings.direction: Verify actual GDN and convolution branches after requesting FlashInfer
findings.reason: Requested FlashInfer prefill does not resolve decode convolution. Inspect the packed decode guard and effective recurrence selection. Qwen3-Next’s interleaved GQA layout excludes the inspected fused CUDA MTP option, while XPU SYCL has its own whole-layer route.
findings.revisit_when: Record the effective operator on the intended backend and distinguish an automatic fallback from an explicitly rejected CUDA configuration.

findings.direction: Use mapped state rows and the accepted-token offset in speculative updates
findings.reason: Batch position and cumulative packed offsets do not own persistent history. The inspected speculative read uses num_accepted_tokens minus one. Convolution history writes and the recurrent matrix must retain their own initialization, padding and row semantics.
findings.revisit_when: For padded and reordered requests, compare both writes using real cache-row mapping, accepted-token metadata and per-rank layout.

findings.direction: Resolve the concrete HF caller before attempting a vLLM conv binding
findings.reason: A common symbol name does not establish equivalence between the vLLM in-tree call chain and standalone Dao, FlashInfer or vendored FLA paths. The unidentified HF implementation leaves projection, state ownership and mutation contracts unresolved.
findings.revisit_when: Pin the caller and compare initial, resumed, mixed, reordered, padded and speculative cases that the eventual binding supports, including state and output parity.
